title: Software constraints and stack notes found in the H20 / H200 harvests
summary: constraints are probe-first hints (never a veto), version-scoped to the stacks they were seen on

message: cublaslt_gemm.cu:409 cuBLAS Error: unsupported value (TE 2.3 FP8 GEMMs on the cuBLAS 12.4 bundled with torch 2.6.0+cu124)
fix: LD_PRELOAD libcublasLt/libcublas >= 12.8 (e.g. from a torch 2.10 cu128 env), or torch >= 2.10 + torchao float8

message: cuBLAS Error: unsupported value (as B1-delayed)
fix: LD_PRELOAD cuBLAS >= 12.8

message: TE 2.3 blockwise FP8 asserts CUDA >= 12.9 at build time; cuBLAS / CUDA 12.9 runtime overlays do not help
fix: rebuild TE with CUDA >= 12.9, or use delayed / tensorwise

message: AssertionError: FSDP requires CUDA_DEVICE_MAX_CONNECTIONS > 1
fix: set CUDA_DEVICE_MAX_CONNECTIONS=8

message: AssertionError: FSDP requires CUDA_DEVICE_MAX_CONNECTIONS > 1
fix: set CUDA_DEVICE_MAX_CONNECTIONS=8 (then B4)

message: TypeError (disable_bucketing) with --use-torch-fsdp2 even at CUDA_DEVICE_MAX_CONNECTIONS=8
fix: do not use --use-torch-fsdp2 in Megatron-Core 0.13 (custom FSDP or the distributed optimizer instead)

message: AssertionError: --optimizer-cpu-offload needs --use-precision-aware-optimizer
fix: add --use-precision-aware-optimizer

message: SDPA memory-efficient backend has no kernel for GQA (torch 2.6 and 2.10; 14/14 kernel shapes)
fix: cuDNN (fastest) or flash SDPA

message: RuntimeError: aten.add.Tensor got mixed torch.Tensor and DTensor (Qwen3 flavours, TP8)
fix: TP <= 4 (TP2 runs, 0.86x of FSDP8 on H20), or FSDP only

message: CPU Adam runs single-threaded under torchrun (OMP_NUM_THREADS=1): 8.6 s per update at 8B, 54-61 s at 32B (DeepSpeed / Megatron hybrid optimizer)
fix: set OMP_NUM_THREADS to the cores per rank (28 gave 1.4-1.7x)

message: FSDP2 CPU offload with OMP_NUM_THREADS=1: the CPU optimizer step dominates (F23 14.5 s vs 10.1 s with 28 threads)
fix: set OMP_NUM_THREADS (28 gave 1.4-1.5x)

message: gradient accumulation fusion needs apex's fused_weight_gradient_mlp_cuda (not installed in these stacks)
fix: pass --no-gradient-accumulation-fusion when apex is missing

message: TE 2.3 --moe-permute-fusion runs but is slower: -6.6 % (H20), -5 % (H200) on Qwen3-30B-A3B EP8
fix: leave permute fusion off with TE 2.3

message: No dot product attention backend is available (TE 2.3 FP8 dot-product attention on cuDNN 9.1)
fix: LD_PRELOAD cuDNN 9.10 (+ cuBLAS 12.8); Megatron-Core 0.13 has no CLI switch: set TransformerConfig.fp8_dot_product_attention

message: loss NaN at iteration 2 (MoE FP8 + --fp8-param-gather + bf16 main grads / moments)
fix: fp32 states (2 nodes) or no fp8 param gather

message: NCCL_SOCKET_NTHREADS=4 x NCCL_NSOCKS_PERTHREAD=4 over TCP: collectives time out
fix: 2 x 2 sockets

message: No available kernel: torch 2.6 SDPA cuDNN backend with head_dim 256 GQA (torch 2.10 has the kernel but a slow backward)
fix: flash SDPA

message: AssertionError (sdpa_input_fn placement): torchtitan TP + CP on torch 2.10 experimental context parallel
fix: CP with FSDP only (CP8 at 32k runs)

message: AssertionError (sdpa_input_fn placement): torchtitan TP + CP on torch 2.10 experimental context parallel
fix: CP with FSDP only (CP8 at 32k runs)

message: AssertionError (sdpa_input_fn placement): torchtitan TP + CP on torch 2.10 experimental context parallel
fix: CP with FSDP only (CP8 at 32k runs)

message: CUDA illegal memory access: --fp8-param-gather with --use-precision-aware-optimizer --main-grads-dtype bf16 (TE 2.3)
fix: fp8 param gather with fp32 main grads (W5N02, HW51b)

message: InductorError: NameError name 'torch' is not defined (torchao 0.15 blockwise FP8 Triton kernels under torch.compile)
fix: run blockwise FP8 eager

text: TE 2.3 on stock cuBLAS 12.4: FP8 impossible (hard error); blockwise impossible on TE 2.3. Measured: startup failure.
mcore FSDP paths: custom FSDP needs CUDA_DEVICE_MAX_CONNECTIONS=8 and works only <= 8B (22.5 GiB allocator slack); --use-torch-fsdp2 broken in 0.13. Measured: M63 2402 @75.6; M73 OOM; M64 TypeError.

FSDP2 CPUOffloadPolicy needs a process group with a CPU backend: with an nccl-only group the CPU-side gradient clipping / optimizer step fails; init_process_group(backend="cpu:gloo,cuda:nccl") (then F23 / F24 ran)
torchtitan 0.2.2: the qwen3 model has no pipelining_fn, so any pipeline-parallel degree fails ("qwen3 does not support pipelining", W5N03); llama3 pipelines (W41, W42, W5N03b)

torchtitan 0.2.2 float8: an explicit quantize.linear.float8.recipe_name together with enable_fsdp_float8_all_gather asserts (W48, W50); leave recipe_name unset with the FSDP float8 all-gather (tensorwise is implied; W48b, W50b ran, +8 %)
SDPA cuDNN with head_dim 256: no kernel on torch 2.6 (2 shapes error); torch 2.10 runs it but the backward is slow (fwd 134 / fwd+bwd 99 TFLOPS on H20 at hq16 hkv2): verify, or use flash SDPA
[reported by an earlier Qwen3.5 smoke test] TE cuDNN fused attention found no execution plan for a Qwen3.5 seq-8192 graph: force the flash backend if TE reports no plan
the global batch must be >= micro-batch x data-parallel size (gbs 16 with mbs 4 on DP8 is an invalid configuration)
transformers 4.57 fails to import with huggingface_hub 1.33: keep huggingface_hub < 1.0 in that env
FSDP2: a custom forward that returns a SimpleNamespace leaves lm_head re-sharded (SIGABRT); return CausalLMOutputWithPast
DeepSpeed config offload_optimizer / offload_param 'none' given as a string turns CPU offload ON silently (4x slower runs that look valid): omit the key or use None
Triton / inductor caches on a shared network filesystem race across hosts (FileNotFoundError triton_poi_fused_*.json): per-host TRITON_CACHE_DIR / TORCHINDUCTOR_CACHE_DIR
TE import needs the env's own nvidia/cudnn/lib first on LD_LIBRARY_PATH (missing libcudnn_adv.so.9; a system cuDNN 9.5 gives libcudnn_heuristic undefined symbols)
[reported] --overlap-p2p-communication-warmup-flush without virtual pipeline stages is a hard error

a hot-restarted runner can leave an orphan training job (its nvidia-smi PIDs live in another namespace): two concurrent runs gave 45.6 s per update instead of 4.2; scan /proc for leftover workers before trusting a measurement
an OOM on one rank can hang the whole job for the NCCL timeout (10 min): kill the job ~90 s after the first OOM
[reported] torch 2.6 Dynamo with Megatron's param-gather hook (Qwen3.5 GDN helper) fails ('list' object is not callable): run that module eagerly
test node-to-node TCP with a raw socket, not curl: an exported HTTP(S)_PROXY / ALL_PROXY makes curl fail and a 2-node setup look impossible
with pipeline parallelism Megatron prints the iteration lines from the last pipeline stage: on multi-node runs parse the log of the node that holds it (rank 0 alone looks like a failed run)
peft 0.21 / accelerate 1.15 do not import with transformers 4.57: peft 0.17.1 + accelerate 1.10.1
torch._scaled_mm with 128x128 block scaling needs CUDA >= 12.9 (torch 2.10 cu128 refuses): torchao Triton blockwise kernels, or a cu129+ build
co-tenant jobs on a shared node collapse throughput (step 2-4x slower, nvidia-smi memory far above torch reserved): check nvidia-smi --query-compute-apps before and after each measurement
